title: Bound gate-heavy run-evidence cuts through CompletionSeal
outcome: Note, checkpoint, and CompletionSeal materialization remain bounded or explicitly aggregated as gate transitions accumulate.
acceptance: A scale regression covers many gate transitions before note, checkpoint, and completion materialize the run evidence cut.

completion.summary: Added a 128-transition scale regression and bounded note, checkpoint, and CompletionSeal run-evidence membership without per-object decoding.
